name: ZoLaiGPT for Android
tagline: A multilingual AI assistant for English, Myanmar and Zomi (Tedim) — beta for Android.
description: ZoLaiGPT for Android is the mobile app of the ZoLaiGPT project: chat, Live voice conversations, the Tedim Bible, pictures, files, subtitles and reading of social links (TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube), in English, Myanmar and Zomi (Tedim). This is a beta: it is installed as an APK from this website and may change. Free accounts get 100 credits every month; optional plans add more credits and models.
features: Chat in English, Myanmar and Zomi (Tedim), with Fast, Thinking and Pro models
Live voice conversations with an animated assistant
Tedim Bible, pictures, files, PDFs and translated subtitles
Reads public TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube links
Free: 100 credits every month; optional paid plans
requirements: About 172 MB of free space for the download
A Gmail account to sign in

notes: Plans & credits page with a launch offer, rub-to-reveal payment QR
Robot assistant in Live and chat, or your own photo
Answers fade in as they are written; quicker, steadier Live replies
Reads TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X, Threads and Reddit links
Full privacy policy and terms in the app

installation: Download the APK and wait until the whole file (about 172 MB) has finished.
Open it and allow installs from your browser or Files app when Android asks.
Install, open ZoLaiGPT and sign in with your Gmail account.
To update later, open the new APK and tap Update — your chats stay. Only if Android says “package conflicts”, uninstall the old app once and install again.

faq.q: Can I download the Android app today?
faq.a: Yes — as a beta APK from this page. Check the SHA-256 checksum above before installing. Download it only from this page or the official GitHub release linked here.

privacyNote: The app's own Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are in the app (Settings → Privacy & terms). Chats are stored on your phone; messages are sent to the ZoLaiGPT server only to get answers.
